title: Southern kings subdued
english: Southern kings fall under Jesus’ lead — Adoni-zedek and his allies. The whole south enters the lot. Figure: southern passions — anger and lust — are laid low under Christ.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: No survivor left breathing
english: [[He left no survivor >> Bible:Joshua 10:40]] — complete victory. In us let no evil thought draw breath. Rest follows finished wars.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Return to Gilgal
english: [[Jesus returned to Gilgal with all Israel >> Bible:Joshua 10:43]] — to circumcision’s and Passover’s place. After victories return to the sacraments. Glory. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).
